title: HIGHLANDER SILVER AND BEAR CREEK MINING ENTER INTO AN AMENDED AND RESTATED ARRANGEMENT AGREEMENT TO REMOVE HIGHLANDER SILVER SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL REQUIREMENT
summary: Toronto, Ontario, January 9, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver”) and Bear Creek Mining Corporation (TSXV: BCM) (OTCQX: BCEKF) (BVL: BCM) (“Bear Creek”) announce today that they have entered into an amended and restated arrangement agreement dated January 9, 2026 (the “A&R Arrangement Agreement”) amending and restating the arrangement agreement dated December 18, 2025 (the “Original Agreement”) pursuant to which Highlander Silver will acquire all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Bear Creek (the “Bear Creek Shares”) (that it does not already own) by way of statutory plan of arrangement under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) (the “Arrangement”).
